name: Meet in mobile remove bottom bar
description:
1. Adaptered `MeetControls.vue` for mobile: the controls bar now stacks and centers below `lg` (1024px) instead of using a fixed 3-column grid, with 44px touch targets and the call duration hidden via `hidden lg:block`.
2. Diagnosed why the same user on two devices (desktop + phone) couldn't see the other device's camera: every layer keyed peers by **username only**, so the second device was treated as "self", filtered out of the tile grid, and its WebRTC signals/offers were dropped.
3. Introduced a device-scoped peer key (`username::sid`, built with `peerIdOf`/`deviceId` in `store/meets.js`) so two sessions of one account become independent peers while the username stays for display.
4. Keyed `peerConnections`, `pendingCandidates` and `remoteStreams` by that peer id, relaxed the self-echo check to require matching session id, and made `MeetView.vue` render remote tiles from `remotePeers` (labelled `(other device)` when the username matches).
5. Fixed `api/connection.js` to send the live `connection.sid` in the `x-sid` header so the backend can route signalling to the specific device; everything degrades to legacy single-device behaviour when `fromSid` is absent.
